RAG-b2df03b9387208fb.quote: The driver was diagnosed with type 2 diabetes several years ago and says the old diet-only label is no longer correct because he now injects insulin each evening, although he cannot name the preparation or dose; after skipping lunch last week he became sweaty and confused in the depot, and a colleague had to bring a sweet drink because he could not organise it himself.

A glucose value of 3.1 mmol/L was recorded only after he started drinking, he denies having passed out, and there is no contemporaneous clinical assessment confirming how severe the episode was; he also describes occasions when the sensor alarm sounded before he noticed symptoms, has not brought three months of monitoring records, and is waiting for endocrinology review.
